_doc: Job_Checkup's command (the checkup activity - Docs/Utnapishtim_Activities/Plan_UtnapishtimActivities.md, Data/Events/Recreation/checkup_events.json). Copied from jp_hospital_csection_operation (Job_CSection): not a furniture command (no 'furniture' tag) - never offered to the ordinary sandbox; the sandbox checkup on a hospital bed is com_furniture_medical_checkup.

list._comment: The doctor as doer, the patient as receiver. Variant 0 = preparing (no receiver yet - a player patient joins it through the join button, alone: joinAlone), variant 1 = examining. doerCount/receiverCount are upper limits; they also make the package joinable (MaxActorCount). Its timeScale is the checkup length; Job_Checkup fires Checkup_Result when it is over. Acceptance: forced by the checkup activity's AcceptanceMods.
list._comment_descriptions: Each variant has its own begin/ongoing text (useBaseDescription false): the preparing one has no receiver, so it must not use the examining text's $receiver$.

zh-cn.checkup_examination_prep_begin_1: $doer.firstname$准备好了检查床，等着开始体检
zh-cn.checkup_examination_begin_1: $doer.firstname$让$receiver.firstname$在检查床上躺好，开始了体检
